findings.message: Native control input manifest omits the existing three --input-lef files, source COMMANDS/config and control method despite direct consumption. Preserve this draft, add exact paths and recheck after native using existing pins loop; product helper/flow can remain byte-identical.

source_review.runner: Only run function nativeflow path/class changed plus method inventory/pins; all other function ASTs exact source03.
